#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;
const int MOD = 1000000007;
const int MAXN = 32;

inline int readInt() {
    int x = 0, f = 1;
    char c = getchar();
    while (c < '0' || c > '9') { if (c == '-') f = -1; c = getchar(); }
    while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') { x = x * 10 + (c - '0'); c = getchar(); }
    return x * f;
}

inline ll readLL() {
    ll x = 0, f = 1;
    char c = getchar();
    while (c < '0' || c > '9') { if (c == '-') f = -1; c = getchar(); }
    while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') { x = x * 10 + (c - '0'); c = getchar(); }
    return x * f;
}

inline void add(int& x, int y) {
    x += y;
    if (x >= MOD) x -= MOD;
}

int n;
struct Matrix {
    int a[MAXN][MAXN];
    void clear() { memset(a, 0, sizeof(a)); }
    void output() {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n + 1; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n + 1; ++j) {
                printf("%d%c", a[i][j], j == n + 1 ? '\n' : ' ');
            }
        }

    }

                for (int k = 1; k <= n + 1; ++k) {
                    add(res.a[i][j], (ll)a[i][k] * rhs.a[k][j] % MOD);
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE

    freopen("matrix.out", "w", stdout);

    ans = E;
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        A[i] = E;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n + 1; ++j) A[i].a[j][i] = 1;
    }
    
    pre[0] = suf[n + 1] = E;

        ll u = m % n;

            ll s = 0;
            for (ll v = m / n; v; v /= n) s = (s + v % n) % n;
            u = (s + u - 1) % n + 1;
            for (; u != s; --u) {
                if (u <= 0) u += n;
                ans = A[u] * ans;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) pre[i] = pre[i - 1] * A[i];
